name: SacAnime
blurb: Sacramento anime convention held three times a year, with voice-actor guests of honor, cosplay, artist alley and gaming.

editions.evidence: Homepage title/text: 'January 8th – 10th, 2027 – SAFE Credit Union Convention Center 1401 K. Street Sacramento, CA 95814'; ticket link path 'sacanime-winter-2027'; confirmed again on the official Future Shows page.
Official Future Shows page (sacanime.com/future-shows/): 'Spring 2027 – Friday, Saturday, and Sunday April 23rd – 25th, 2027 Cal Expo'.
Official Future Shows page (sacanime.com/future-shows/): 'Summer 2027 – Friday, Saturday, and Sunday September 3rd – 5th, 2027 Sacramento (SAFE Credit Union) Convention Center'.

notes: SacAnime runs 3 shows a year (one file, one edition per show per the multi-show special case); Spring 2027 moves to Cal Expo while Winter and Summer use the SAFE Credit Union Convention Center, both in Sacramento. Only Winter 2027 has guests announced; its guest_list grid (19 photos) only captions each person as 'SacAnime Winter 2027 Welcomes <Name>' with no credit text, so Known for is blank for most. A WebFetch of the con's own Guests of Honor announcement posts (sacanime.com/category/guests-of-honor/) surfaced clean, specific credits for only 2 of the 19 (Cristina Vee / Sailor Mars, Brandon Keener / Garrus Vakarian) that matched well enough to use; the other posts either weren't returned by that fetch or gave vague/unclear specifics (e.g. Ali Hillis, DC Douglas, Mark Meer), so those are left blank rather than guessed. No organizer name appears anywhere on the site (copyright line is blank: 'Copyright © 2026 . All rights reserved.'), so organizer is left blank. A separate, differently-branded 'Sac-Con/Sac Comic-Con' show (April 10-11, 2027, same venue) is also listed on the Future Shows page but is a different event from SacAnime and out of scope for this id. Refute-pass (2026-10-05): re-extracted fresh (pipeline/cache/extract/sacanime-v2.guests.json) -- all 19 picks are individually captioned 'SacAnime Winter 2027 Welcomes <Name>' and filed under image names prefixed 'saw27_web_banners_...' (saw27 = SacAnime Winter '27), uploaded 2026/09; Winter 2027 lineup upheld in full.
